summary: Indivior Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on August 1, 2026, announcing entry into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Supernus Pharmaceuticals. Indivior's wholly owned subsidiary, Artemis Merger Sub, will merge with and into Supernus, with Supernus surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Indivior, which will rename itself Supernus, Inc. Each Supernus share is converted into 1.5401 Indivior shares (stock consideration). Supernus RSUs and PSUs are assumed and converted into Indivior RSUs, with PSUs vesting on a time-based schedule. The deal is a stock-for-stock merger. Watch for shareholder votes, regulatory approvals, and closing conditions; risk-arb focuses on exchange ratio and deal completion timeline.
